subject: Exec briefing: competitor pricing shifts + model release playbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec briefing: competitor pricing shifts + model release playbook

Team — sending a concise roundup ahead of Monday's OKR slot and the QBR workshop next week. High-level takeaways first, then ask.

Top-line:
- Aureus AI rolled a public pricing play this morning: a two-tier per-token + concurrency bundle targeting mid-market (announced via blog + partner net). Rate suggests unit cost drop ~18% for typical chat workloads.
- Aureus also released v2.1 of their 70B (sparse attention variant) with a claim of 1.6x latency improvement on 8xA100; early bench suggests quality parity on commonsense tasks.
- CloudCo announced a marketplace promotion (30% credit for 90 days) for new inference customers in EMEA; could surface as a procurement win for existing prospects.

Why it matters:
- Pricing moves compress mid-market willingness to pay; our Dedicated and Private upsell motion (predictable latencies + SLAs) is a key counter.
- Model release increases pressure on our verified performance story — need updated perf vs. Aureus v2.1 and guidance on quantization tradeoffs.

Immediate asks (owners + timeline):
1) Competitive slide (one-pager): quick matrix comparing our offering vs. Aureus v2.1 and CloudCo marketplace play. Data points: pricing, latency, SLA, private deploy footprint. Owner: Laura. Due: Tue EOD (26 Apr).
2) Benchmark note: run 3 short benches (chat latency at 1k/4k contexts, throughput at 16 concurrent connections) comparing Aureus v2.1 (public weights) + our recommended quant profiles. Owner: Markus + Infra. Due: Wed noon (27 Apr).
3) Pricing response recommendation: 2 options — promotional credit for new mid-market deals vs. structured discounts for Dedicated commits. Outline pros/cons and impact on ARR cadence. Owner: Aditya. Due: Wed EOD (27 Apr).
4) QBR pack: one slide with narrative + link to one-pager, and a data snippet for the board. Owner: Marissa. Due: Thu morning (28 Apr).

Attachments: competitor_matrix.xlsx (working matrix), pricing-moves-timeline.csv (source links), qbr-onepager-draft.pdf (starter).

I'll consolidate inputs on Thu afternoon and circulate the final slide for review. If anyone sees urgent references (press, partner emails), drop into the Drive folder immediately.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Field Strategy & Market Ops
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.ai>; markus_klein@redwood.ai; aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec briefing: competitor pricing shifts + model release playbook

Jonas — thanks for the clear asks. Quick notes from comms and field: 

- Aureus blog post surfaced in our AE calls this morning; several reps reported prospecting pushbacks around "cheaper per-token economics" for proof-of-concept pilots.
- CloudCo marketplace is definitely driving easy procurement for smaller customers in EMEA — we've got two inbound leads that referenced the marketplace credit.

I'll take the one-pager and populate the market positioning bullets + a slide frame that emphasizes our cost controls (batching, KV cache) and the SLA delta. Draft in Drive by Tue 17:00 PT.

Attachment: laura_notes.odt (short notes from field).

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -0700, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jonas / team — infra will spin the benches but need clarifications:
> 
> - Which Aureus endpoint/version should we target? I can use the public 70B v2.1 weights (tag v2.1-prod) unless someone prefers a different commit.
> - For quant profiles: should we run FP16 baseline + INT4 aggressive profile + our standard quant baseline? That gives a clear trade space.
> - We'll share raw numbers and a one-page synthesis; I propose we call out 95th percentile latencies for chat and p50 for throughput.
> 
> Assigning infra: Diego Fernandez + Ethan Park. ETA: Wed 12:00 PT.
> 
> Markus Klein
> Director, Infrastructure & Performance
> 
On Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — pricing note attached (pricing-moves-timeline.csv). My quick read: Aureus' bundle is aggressive up front but has constraints on concurrency; it looks designed to win POC volume not sustained committed spend. Two tactical options:
> 
> 1) Time-limited promotional credit (60 days) for net-new mid-market customers who commit to a 6-month Dedicated trial. Upside: preserves ARR motion. Downside: margin hit short-term.
> 2) Structured commit discount: >$X/month for Dedicated -> 12% discount on list with tightened SLA term; Upside: predictable revenue. Downside: longer sales cycles.
> 
> I'll model ARR impact and attach a quick sensitivity table by EOD Wed.
> 
> Aditya Rao
> Head of Sales Strategy

On Wed, 28 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks all — I've started the QBR slide and put the one-pager link into the QBR folder. Two quick asks for finalization:
> 
> - Laura: can you give me the two-line positioning we want to use on slide 3 (competitor + our counter)? Need by 3pm Thu.
> - Markus: attach the bench synthesis (PDF) into the Drive folder when ready.
> 
> I'll stitch together a 2-minute narrative for the leadership QBR and include a callout for sales motions.
>
> Attachment: qbr-slide-v0.pptx (working).
>
> Marissa Cole
> Head of Product Marketing
>
On Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Received all — appreciate the quick turn. Final notes before I package: 
> 
> - Laura: prioritize the slide that maps "where customers choose us" (Dedicated/private/hosted) vs. Aureus. Keep it evidence-based (cite procurement responses).
> - Markus: call out any edge cases where Aureus latency claim materially beats our config; if none, mark as "no material lead".
> - Aditya: include recommended language for AEs to use when prospects point to the Aureus pricing (two bullets).
> - Marissa: I'll review the one-pager by 6pm and push final slide to the QBR deck.
> 
> Closing ask: If anyone sees a direct customer exec email thread referencing Aureus or CloudCo (procurement offers, credit links), drop it in the Drive folder and tag me — I'll escalate with Legal/Contracts if needed.
> 
> I'll circulate the final QBR market slide by Thu 18:30 PT.
>
> Jonas
>
